items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: Yes, very good. He was very good. You remember Warrington, huh?

ctx.x: But I used to, like I said. Johnny Warrington, did you like him?
Yes, very good. He was very good. You remember Warrington, huh? Yeah, they have a lot of Warrington arrangements here.
Yeah, yeah. He was very good.
